Entries.Text: Copies dummies and materials into the loaded model: from another model, or from a JSON file exported here (from any game). Dummies find their bones by name, materials keep their texture paths and GX lists. Each copy is one undo step.
Load the model to copy into.
The model to copy from. Unsaved edits to it are included.
Type part of a file name (c4100, wp_a_0200, aeg099_090) to list matching models.
The file holds several models; pick the one to copy from.
Search for a model above and pick it.
Tick the dummies to copy. Rows show [reference ID] parent bone / attach bone.
Show only these reference IDs: 220, 200-299, or 100, 120. Empty shows all.
Tick the materials to copy, with their textures.
How dummies and materials go into the loaded model.
A dummy whose parent or attach bone the loaded model doesn't have (by name) isn't copied. The log lists them.
Put them at the top level
Such a dummy is copied with no parent or attach bone. Its position is then in the model's space, which may differ from where it was.
Added to every copied dummy's reference ID (0 keeps them). IDs that would leave -32768 to 32767 are skipped.
Every material is added at the end, renamed (_1, _2…) if the name is taken.
A material whose name the loaded model has replaces that one's MTD, textures and GX list, so the meshes using it change. Others are added.
Copies each material's GX list (shader settings in later games), reusing an identical one the model already has. Off leaves new materials without one.
The loaded model lacks {0} bones the dummies use, so those dummies will be skipped: {1}
The loaded model lacks {0} bones the dummies use, so those dummies go to the top level: {1}
Adds the objects to the loaded model.
Adds them as one undo step. Texture files aren't copied: the paths only work if the textures are available to the model.
Added {0} dummies, added {1} and replaced {2} materials, added {3} GX lists, in {4}.
Writes the loaded model's dummies and materials to a JSON file (or the clipboard), to import into other models later.
Includes materials, with their textures and GX lists.
Only the dummies and materials selected in Contents or the viewport. Off exports all of them.
Asks where to save the JSON file (the project's output folder by default).
Puts the same JSON on the clipboard, to paste into Import in another view or project.
Copied {0} dummies and {1} materials to the clipboard.
Reads dummies and materials exported here, to add to the loaded model.
Picks a JSON file exported by Data Transfer.
Reads JSON copied with Copy to Clipboard.
Open a file or read the clipboard.
This data comes from {0}, and the project is {1}. Bones are matched by name, but MTD paths and GX lists may not suit this game; consider turning off Copy GX lists.
it isn't a Data Transfer file
